displayName: Research a candidate before an interview
summary: Walk into any interview with a quick profile on the person you're meeting.

useCases.title: Research a candidate before an interview
useCases.message: Help me prepare to interview a candidate. Ask me who I'm meeting and for which role. If you don't already know which ATS I use, ask. Then go through their LinkedIn, any public work or portfolio, and their application in my ATS. Give me a quick profile covering their background, what stands out, and angles worth exploring in the conversation.
